title: `check-error-status-conformance.mjs` `walk()` races tsup's transient `packages/spec/tsup.config.bundled_*.mjs`: readdir-then-stat throws ENOENT and turns the required `Test Core (1/6)` red with 597 / 597 tests passed
body:
Filing-gate category ① — a reproducible platform defect with a named site, measured by the #17707 patch-round dev (os-dev-report on #17707, 2026-09-27) and filed by the director seat (`session_01AsCNgFBs8HCjwhyHQsFbx3`) under 「谁发现 flake 谁修或立单」. Filed unlabelled beyond `finding`: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happened

- PR #19957 head `e9f9b060f3`, CI run 35970801403, job 107539910149 `Test Core (1/6)`: `@objectstack/spec:test:repo` reported `FAIL src/api/error-catalog-docs.test.ts` at suite load — `Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, stat …/packages/spec/tsup.config.bundled_y2twvadpiyp.mjs` at `walk` (`scripts/check-error-status-conformance.mjs:1832`) ← `scanSources` (`:1847`) ← `deriveWireFace` (`:1892`) ← `src/api/error-catalog-docs.test.ts:55`. The shard's verdict: `Test Files 1 failed | 34 passed (35)`, `Tests 597 passed (597)`. The required roll-up `Test Core` went red with it.
- Producer: tsup writes a transient `packages/spec/tsup.config.bundled_<id>.mjs` while `@objectstack/spec#build` runs; in the same turbo invocation `@objectstack/spec#test:repo` scans `packages/spec` with `walk()`, which does `readdirSync` and then `statSync` per entry with no tolerance for an entry that vanishes in between.
- `walk()` is untouched by PR #19957 and byte-identical on `origin/main` `03d6cb04ae` (lines 1798–1805, last changed by `bac22eb73a`).

## Reproduction

- Sequentially the race does not reproduce: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo` on a driver-free rebuild of the red run's merge ref (`e9f9b060f3` + main `3b5607019f`) passes 35 / 35 files, 602 / 602 tests; on the PR's new head `628738ddf4` it passes 32 / 32.
- Race probe (throwaway worktree, removed afterwards): a sibling process loops create / delete of `packages/spec/tsup.config.bundled_probe.mjs` while `deriveWireFace()` scans — result `{runs: 4, enoent: 2}` with the same `ENOENT … stat` at `statSync`; the control scan without churn completes in about 8.7 s. No file left behind.

## Fix direction (for the lane that owns the gate script)

In its own PR with a `--self-test` case: `walk()` tolerates an entry that disappears between `readdir` and `stat` (skip it, or `lstat` inside a try that swallows `ENOENT` only), or the scan excludes tsup's transient `tsup.config.bundled_*.mjs` pattern by name. Whether other walkers in `scripts/` share this shape was not measured; a census is part of the fix.

Governing text: the standing rule 「谁发现 flake 谁修或立单,⛔ 不绕行」 and the PR-drive rule that a flake is never a root cause; `docs/qa` gate scripts are judged by content (this is a gate-script defect, not a spec change).

Dedupe words: `check-error-status-conformance walk ENOENT` · `tsup.config.bundled` · `error-catalog-docs.test.ts flake` · `readdir stat race` · `deriveWireFace scanSources`
